summary: Rule out opposite signs. If ℓ ∣ N₁: ℓ divides the norm of c₀ = (1+√−d)/2, and an isometry exchanging e(c₀) and 1 − e(c₀) contradicts the ultrametric inequality. If ℓ ∤ N₁ (so ℓ = d): the ratio of the two thick places would have class −d^n mod N₀, but it has class 1, and d^n ≢ −1.

steps.claim: Units of ℤ are ±1; it suffices to exclude cmSign σ = −cmSign σ'. Split on ℓ ∣ N₁.
steps.lean: cmSign (complexEmbOf e g') := units_ne_iff_eq_neg.not_right.2 fun _ ↦ if b : ℓ ∣ D.N₁ then by

steps.claim: ℓ ∣ N₁: let x = e(c₀), c₀ = (1 + √−d)/2. With opposite signs, g(ιℓσ(√−d)) + ... gives (gg'⁻¹)(2x − 1) = −(2x − 1), so the isometry gg'⁻¹ exchanges x and 1 − x and ‖x‖ = ‖1 − x‖; ℓ divides (d + 1)/4 = c₀(1 − c₀) (dvd_norm_c₀, c₀InE_mul_one_sub), so ‖x‖·‖1 − x‖ < 1, while 1 = ‖x + (1 − x)‖ ≤ max(‖x‖, ‖1 − x‖) (ultrametric): contradiction.
steps.lean:
let x := e (P.c₀InE D.s)
    rcases congr(g (ιℓ ($((cmSign_spec (complexEmbOf e g)).1) + $((cmSign_spec
      (complexEmbOf e g')).1)))), P.dvd_norm_c₀ out b, congr(‖e $(P.c₀InE_mul_one_sub D.s)‖),
      IsUltrametricDist.norm_add_le_max x (1 - x), dist_smul (g * g'⁻¹) x 0
    simp_all [sqrtNegDInE, map_ofNat, complexEmbOf, ← Padic.norm_natCast_lt_one_iff,
      ← PadicAlgCl.norm_extends]
    grind [sq_nonneg (‖x‖ - 1), sq]

steps.claim: ℓ ∤ N₁, so ℓ = d: g'g⁻¹ acts on ζ (of order N₁ prime to ℓ) as an ℓ^n-th power (exists_apply_eq_pow); placeClass_ratio with a = 0 and m = N₀ gives the class −d^n for the ratio of the two places under opposite signs, while both thick places have class −1 (placeClass_of_thick), so the ratio has class 1; d^n ≢ −1 mod N₀ (pow_d_ne_neg_one).
steps.lean:
else (exists_apply_eq_pow b (by simp [← map_pow,
  isPrimitiveRoot_zeta.1]) _).elim fun n ↦ mt (placeClass_ratio e g g' 0 n · _ ⟨_, rfl⟩ (by simp))
  (by simp_all [D.placeClass_of_thick, hp.1.dvd_mul, Nat.prime_dvd_prime_iff_eq, out]; grind
  [pow_d_ne_neg_one])
